# WP-CLI

- Project: https://wp-cli.org · source: https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli
- **Not bundled:** WEBit downloads the latest release (`wp-cli-X.phar`) on request from GitHub into `data\modules\wpcli\wp-cli.phar`, verified with the checksum of the release.
